# Exfoliating Loofah Pad: Gentle, Natural Body Scrubber for Men and Women

## Natural Exfoliation Without the Harsh Chemicals

This 2-pack of 100% natural loofah sponge pads gives you effective exfoliation with a gentle touch. Made from chemical-free loofah, each pad delivers natural abrasion that lifts away dry skin and clears away impurities, so your pores can breathe.

## Designed to Fit Your Hand

The elastic hand strap and soft terry cloth backing turn each pad into a glove that stays secure as you scrub. Reach your back, shoulders, and legs with ease. The 4.3 x 5.9 inch size fits comfortably in your palm, and the terry side offers a softer option for sensitive areas.

## Lather Less, Feel More

These pads build a rich, silky lather with less shower gel than standard washcloths. Work them over your body to cleanse deeply, and enjoy skin that feels smooth after every shower or bath.

## Easy Care, Lasting Use

Soak the loofah until it softens, then rinse and wring it out after each use. Hand washing keeps the pads fresh between uses. Because the loofah wrings out easily, it resists the odor buildup common with traditional loofah pieces.

## Ideal for Everyday Routines

Whether you want a spa-style bath experience at home or a simple daily cleanse, these pads make body care feel effortless. They're a practical choice for anyone with dry or rough-feeling skin, and they're well suited to people who manage psoriasis or eczema, though we recommend checking with your dermatologist first.

## Try Them Risk-Free

Give your skin the care it deserves. Add the Exfoliating Loofah Pad 2-Pack to your cart today and discover the difference a natural scrub can make.
